from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    if horizontal:
        r = horizontal[len(horizontal)//2]
        top_framed = all(v == g[r][0] for v in g[0])
        source = r-1 if top_framed else r+1
        candidates = range(r+1, h) if top_framed else range(r-1, -1, -1)
        patterned = [y for y in candidates if len(set(g[y])) > 1]
        target = patterned[-1] if top_framed else patterned[0]
        toward = 1 if top_framed else -1
        edge = h-1 if top_framed else 0
        background = Counter(g[target]).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(w):
            if g[source][c] == g[target][c]:
                if g[source][c] != background:
                    g[target-toward][c] = g[source][c]
            else:
                value = g[target][c]
                g[target][c] = background
                if value != background:
                    g[edge][c] = value
        return g

    c = next(c for c in range(w)
             if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h))) == 1)
    left_framed = all(g[0][x] == g[0][c] for x in range(c+1))
    source = c-1 if left_framed else c+1
    candidates = range(c+1, w) if left_framed else range(c-1, -1, -1)
    patterned = [x for x in candidates
                 if len(set(g[r][x] for r in range(h))) > 1]
    target = patterned[-1] if left_framed else patterned[0]
    toward = 1 if left_framed else -1
    edge = w-1 if left_framed else 0
    background = Counter(g[r][target] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(h):
        if g[r][source] == g[r][target]:
            if g[r][source] != background:
                g[r][target-toward] = g[r][source]
        else:
            value = g[r][target]
            g[r][target] = background
            if value != background:
                g[r][edge] = value
    return g
